components.name: reach2d_pd
components.summary: Proportional controller with configurable noise, hesitation and recovery demos.

components.name: random
components.summary: Uniform random actions (sanity checks, exploration data).

components.name: gym
components.summary: Any gymnasium env (PushT, ALOHA, LIBERO...) with a key map to pipeline features.

components.name: reach2d
components.summary: Language-conditioned 2D reaching with coloured targets (pure numpy, fast).

params.name: goal_colors
params.help: colours that can be the goal

components.name: tiny_cnn
components.summary: From-scratch CNN + hashed word embeddings + fusion transformer. No pretraining, CPU-fast.

params.name: film
params.help: FiLM-condition conv features on the instruction (RT-1)

components.name: hf_vlm
components.summary: Pretrained HF VLM as the prefix encoder; layer truncation, freezing and LoRA are options.

params.name: path
params.help: local weights (e.g. from the vlm stage)

params.name: num_layers
params.help: keep first N LM layers (SmolVLA: half)

params.name: fast_preprocess
params.help: resize/normalise images on the GPU and cache tokenised prompts (falls back if unsupported)

components.name: mlp
components.summary: Two-layer MLP -> k tokens (default for state / force vectors).

components.name: fourier
components.summary: Random Fourier features + MLP; sharper for low-dim positions.

components.name: conv_grid
components.summary: Small CNN for grid sensors (tactile pads, depth patches) -> pool x pool tokens.

components.name: flow_matching
components.summary: Noise -> action chunk by integrating a learned velocity field (pi0 / SmolVLA / GR00T).

components.name: diffusion
components.summary: DDPM-trained epsilon predictor, DDIM sampling (Diffusion Policy, Octo).

components.name: l1_regression
components.summary: Parallel decoding of the whole chunk with learned queries and an L1 loss (OFT, ACT).

components.name: discrete_bins
components.summary: Each action dim split into 256 bins and classified (RT-2 / OpenVLA), decoded in parallel.

components.name: sync
components.summary: Receding horizon: run the policy, execute the first n actions, re-plan.

components.name: temporal_ensemble
components.summary: Infer every tick and average all chunks that cover the current tick (ACT).

params.name: k
params.help: w_i = exp(-k * i), i = 0 for the oldest prediction

components.name: rtc_blend
components.summary: Latency-aware: skips actions consumed during inference and blends into the new chunk.
components.doc: Output-space approximation of RTC. True RTC inpaints during denoising (see docs/papers.md).

params.name: blend
params.help: ticks over which the old chunk hands over to the new one

components.name: sim
components.summary: Drive a simulator through the real-time loop (same code path as hardware).

components.name: mock
components.summary: Hardware-free robot that matches any embodiment spec (test loops, rates, new sensors).
components.doc:
First-order joint dynamics + random images, shaped by the spec. Every declared sensor is filled,
so a brand new feedback channel can be exercised end to end before the hardware exists.

components.name: lerobot_robot
components.summary: Any LeRobot-supported robot (SO-100/101, Koch, ALOHA, LeKiwi ...) via its robot config.
components.doc: Adapter over ``lerobot.robots``. Not exercised in CI (needs hardware); see docs/hardware.md.

params.name: state_keys
params.help: lerobot keys stacked into the state

components.name: clamp
components.summary: Clamp actions to the embodiment's joint / command limits.

components.name: rate_limit
components.summary: Limit the change between consecutive commands (velocity clamp).

components.name: deadman
components.summary: Repeat the last safe command (hold) if the policy stops producing actions in time.

components.name: data/scripted_sim
components.summary: Roll a scripted expert in sim and log LeRobot-style episodes.

components.name: data/lerobot_hub
components.summary: Any LeRobot dataset on the Hub (ALOHA, PushT, SO-100, DROID, LIBERO ...) as a source.

params.name: episodes
params.help: list, or N for the first N

components.name: data/mixture
components.summary: Weighted mixture of several datasets (cross-embodiment / co-training).

components.name: data/synthetic
components.summary: Random data shaped by the embodiment spec: bring-up tests for new robots / sensors.
components.doc:
Fills every feature the spec declares (cameras, state, new sensors) so the full stack - dataset,
policy encoders, runtime loop - can be exercised before any real data exists.

components.name: deploy/loop
components.summary: observe -> infer (async) -> act at control_hz with safety filters and episode logging.

components.name: edge/optimize
components.summary: Benchmark dtype / flow-step / compile / int8 variants and ship one via runtime.yaml.

components.name: eval/sim_rollout
components.summary: N seeded rollouts -> success rate with a 95% Wilson interval, per-task and failure triage.

components.name: eval/offline
components.summary: Action MSE / L1 on held-out demos. Cheap, and only loosely tied to real success.

components.name: eval/gate
components.summary: Compare a candidate report to a baseline; fail (or flag) if it regresses.

optional_inputs.policy: candidate policy (passed through if the gate opens)

components.name: post_train/finetune
components.summary: Fine-tune a pretrained VLA on target data: full, frozen-backbone, head-only or LoRA.

components.name: rl/filtered_bc
components.summary: Rollout -> keep successes -> fine-tune, repeat. Success should climb each iteration.

params.name: demo_weight
params.help: sampling weight of the original demos

optional_inputs.dataset: original demos to keep mixing in

components.name: rl/dsrl
components.summary: RL in the latent-noise space of a frozen flow policy (REINFORCE on success).

components.name: vla/train
components.summary: Train the native VLA: any backbone + obs encoders + action head on a dataset mixture.

optional_inputs.backbone: backbone spec from the vlm stage

components.name: vla/lerobot_train
components.summary: Train / fine-tune any LeRobot policy (SmolVLA, ACT, Diffusion, pi0, GR00T ...) via lerobot-train.

params.name: key_map
params.help: spec key -> policy key, for eval

components.name: vlm/scratch
components.summary: Skip web pretraining: a small backbone trained from scratch with the policy.

components.name: vlm/hf_pretrained
components.summary: Use a web-pretrained VLM as-is and probe its spatial skills on robot images.

params.name: probe_env
params.help: env for probe images (default: pipeline env)

components.name: vlm/er_finetune
components.summary: Fine-tune the VLM on pointing / scene QA rendered from the sim before robot training.

vlm.name: Embodied-reasoning fine-tune (Gemini Robotics-ER / pi0.5 pointing data)

vla.name: Knowledge insulation (stop action-expert gradients into the VLM)
Joint (blockwise-causal) attention prefix instead of cross-attention

data.name: Scripted sim demos with noise / hesitation / recovery knobs
Spec-shaped synthetic data for hardware bring-up
ALOHA / GELLO / SO-100 leader-follower teleop recording

post_train.name: Data curation / filtering of hesitant demos

rl.name: DSRL - RL in the latent-noise space
Residual RL on top of a frozen VLA

eval.name: Seeded sim rollouts + 95% Wilson interval + failure triage
Offline action error on held-out demos
PushT / ALOHA / LIBERO / MetaWorld sims via gymnasium

edge.name: Prefix KV caching (re-run only the expert while denoising)

deploy.name: Real-time chunking by inpainting during denoising
Async inference control loop + safety filters + episode logging

pipelines.name: reach_full
pipelines.description: SmolVLM2 backbone with pointing fine-tune, SmolVLA-style flow policy, all eight stages.

pipelines.name: reach_heads
pipelines.description: Same data and backbone, four action heads.

pipelines.name: reach_smoke
pipelines.description: Every stage on the Lang-Reach 2D sim with a tiny from-scratch backbone.

presets.name: vla/flow_tiny
presets.paper: pi0 (flow matching), RT-1 FiLM CNN backbone

spec.task: Pick up the cube with the right arm and transfer it to the left arm.
Push the T-shaped block onto the T-shaped target.
